scope_at_13.decomposition: For odd p the idempotents (1 +- sigma)/2 are in Z_p[Gal(K/Q)], so Sha(E/K)[13] = Sha(E/Q)[13] (+) Sha(E^{-23}/Q)[13]. Hence I_3 = F_13 <=> Sha(E/Q)[13] = 0 AND Sha(E^{-23}/Q)[13] = 0 -- a CONJUNCTION.
scope_at_13.success_vs_failure: Success gives both 13-parts. FAILURE IS AMBIGUOUS: Sha(E^{-23}/Q)[13] != 0 makes the ideal proper even when the seed 13-part vanishes, so a negative outcome is not evidence about the seed.
scope_at_13.twist_side: Certified ord L(E^{-23},1) = 1 gives rank 1 and Sha(E^{-23}/Q) FINITE via GZK applied to the TWIST over Q; it gives nothing about its 13-part. The two Heegner settings differ: E/K has ord = 2+1 = 3 so y_K is torsion and Kolyvagin does NOT apply to E/K; the twist has analytic rank 1 and GZK applies to IT, over its own auxiliary field satisfying the Heegner hypothesis for E^{-23}, not K. Bounding Sha(E^{-23}/Q)[13] is a SEPARATE Heegner-index computation over a different field; shape known, not supplied, not proposed.
